sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Deal magic damage (Fire) 5 times that penetrates damage reduction and damage reflection effects with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 120.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Mastery (increases the maximum number of Defense Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Wicked Eclipse (decreases status ailment resistance by 50, reduces Cost recovery speed by 10, increases Ability Cost consumption by 100%, disables Unison gauge filling from Ability, Unison, and Skill effects (Unison gauge fill from taking damage or using Abilities remains unaffected)) to the enemy Field for 90 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 50000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 150 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).

[Investigation Team] Yukiko Amagi or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
